The '''22nd [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in film and television for 1964, were held on February 8, 1965.

==Winners and nominees==
[[File:Peter O'Toole - 1968.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Peter O'Toole]] won for ''[[Becket (1964 film)|Becket]]'']]
[[File:Anne Bancroft 1952.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Anne Bancroft]] won for ''[[The Pumpkin Eater]]'']]
[[File:Rex Harrison 7 Allan Warren.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Rex Harrison]] won for ''[[My Fair Lady (film)|My Fair Lady]]'']]
[[File:Julie Andrews 1965 crop.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Dame Julie Andrews]] won for ''[[Mary Poppins (film)|Mary Poppins]]'']]
[[File:Studio publicity Agnes Moorehead.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Agnes Moorehead]] won for ''[[Hush...Hush, Sweet Charlotte]]'']]
